overreach: The supported signal-integrity capabilities for wireless communication applications are...
review.reason: The core recommendation—high-speed PCB/channel SI, interface validation, clock jitter, PDN/power integrity, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and related VNA/probe/scope/source tooling—is supported by passages [2], [7], [33], and the wireless-infrastructure connection in [46]. However, the cited passages do not explicitly rank these as the 'most important,' and the mmWave/OTA/MIMO items are supported as wireless test capabilities but not clearly as signal-integrity capabilities.
